description: Upload an audio clip (music, voiceover, SFX; mp3/wav/m4a/aac/ogg/flac, up to 50MB) into the publisher-bound AR project via audio_url. Returns media_url to pass to set_publisher_video_audio. The clip is not an asset row of its own and cannot be published on a calendar row.

audio_filename.description: Filename hint with extension (e.g. launch-bed.wav). Taken from audio_url when omitted.

audio_url.description: Public https URL to download the audio from (mp3/wav/m4a/aac/ogg/flac, up to 50MB).

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

publisher_pid.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project.

name: upload_publisher_audio
